from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class DocumentFacts(BaseModel):
    """Extracted information from a single judgment document."""
    title: str | None = Field(description="The full title of the judgment document as written in the document")
    cause_of_action: str | None = Field(description="The cause of action (案由) explicitly identified in the document")
    document_type: str | None = Field(description="The type of legal document (e.g., 判决书，裁定书，通知书)")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    document_facts: list[DocumentFacts]
